Topographic map of the city of Beijing (2 walled districts) and its surrounding rural areas. Shows government and imperial buildings in the urban areas; and shows roads, villages, individual buildings, tilled fields, and wooded areas in the surrounding rural zone. Relief shown by hachures. Title from upper map border. Sectioned to 16 panels to enable folding and mounted on cloth backing. Includes statement of attribution in the lower map border. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. In old-orthography Russian. Acquisitions control no. 2000-58
